description: This file generates an Open Graph image for a travel-related post, fetching post data server-side and rendering styled SVG/HTML content as an image response using Next.js Edge runtime and @vercel/og.

methods.name: fetchPost
methods.description: Fetches post data asynchronously given an ID and base URL, returning a Post object or null.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: Handles incoming requests to generate an Open Graph image for a specific post, retrieving post data and rendering styled image content.
